Task: Managed Log Query / Log Ingestion

Write Python code that writes application log events that include a shared request or correlation identifier using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import uuid
import requests
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

# Provider-identifying signal: Datadog HTTP Log API endpoint and provider-specific environment variable
DATADOG_API_KEY = os.getenv("DD_API_KEY", "your-datadog-api-key-here")
DATADOG_LOGS_URL = f"https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/v1/input/{DATADOG_API_KEY}"

def write_correlated_log(
    correlation_id: str, 
    message: str, 
    status: str = "INFO", 
    extra_attrs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
) -> bool:
    """
    Writes an application log event to Datadog with a shared request correlation identifier.
    """
    log_payload = [{
        "message": message,
        "ddsource": "python-application",
        "service": "api-service",
        "hostname": "app-server-01",
        "status": status,
        "correlation_id": correlation_id,
        **(extra_attrs or {})
    }]

    response = requests.post(
        DATADOG_LOGS_URL,
        json=log_payload,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.status_code == 202

def handle_user_request(user_data: Dict[str, Any]):
    # Generate a shared request/correlation ID for the lifecycle of this request
    correlation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    
    # Log the start of the request with the shared correlation ID
    write_correlated_log(
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
        message="Received user request",
        status="INFO",
        extra_attrs={"endpoint": "/users/login", "user_id": user_data.get("id")}
    )
    
    # Simulate application processing
    # ... logic here ...
    
    # Log the completion of the request using the same correlation ID
    write_correlated_log(
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
        message="Successfully processed user request",
        status="DEBUG",
        extra_attrs={"records_updated": 1}
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    handle_user_request({"id": "user_123", "email": "alice@example.com"})
